claim: Nothing records before you start.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile with the unpacked extension; assert capture storage is empty before Start

claim: Typed values never enter the packet.
where: landing facts, extension facts, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile; type unique secrets into textarea and contenteditable controls; assert storage, preview, Markdown, and JSON omit every value

claim: Password values never enter the packet.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile; type a unique password and assert storage plus both exported formats omit it

claim: The extension does not copy the page content.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile; click a paragraph containing unique private page copy and assert storage, preview, Markdown, and JSON omit it

claim: A preview appears before export.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile; stop a capture, assert the preview and both export actions are visible before either file is created

claim: The extension does not export a packet without your action.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile; start and stop capture, assert zero downloads until an export action is clicked

claim: The extension records only the page where you start.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile; start on demo, navigate to privacy, click an injected control, and assert no event is added after navigation

claim: Recording stops after 30 seconds.
where: landing how-it-works, extension first screen, README
sandbox: unit fixture with a capture at the exact limit; assert the constant and exported duration are 30 seconds

claim: Exports Markdown and JSON.
sandbox: fresh demo context; download both files, parse JSON, and inspect Markdown content

claim: The packet keeps the captured page address and title.
sandbox: fresh demo context; export Markdown and JSON and assert both contain the sample page address and title

claim: The packet keeps time-ordered focus, click, and control-key events with control labels and roles.
where: landing preview and hero caption, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; export JSON and assert the sample focus, click, and key events remain ordered and each has a label and role

claim: The packet keeps the user-written goal or note.
where: landing preview and how-it-works, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; enter a unique note, export Markdown and JSON, and assert both contain that exact note

claim: Individual exports cost $0.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile with the unpacked extension; capture one control, export JSON, and assert no payment endpoint or payment step is used

claim: Capture and export work offline.
sandbox: fresh persistent Chromium profile; load a normal page online, switch offline, start the unpacked extension, click a control, stop, and export JSON containing that event

claim: The sample packet reloads and exports offline after its first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open ?demo=1 online, wait for the site worker, switch offline, reload, and export Markdown

claim: The one-click demo uses separate sample data and sends nothing outside the site.
where: demo banner, demo note, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh ?demo=1 context; assert the banner and reset action, edit the sample note, inspect localStorage keys, and assert no cross-origin request

claim: Sensitive URL parameters and fragments are removed from exports.
sandbox: unit fixtures with patient, diagnosis, token, and fragment values; assert every query value and fragment is absent

claim: Capture data stays in browser-local extension storage.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; complete a capture and inspect chrome.storage.local

claim: The extension does not capture screenshots.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; inspect the completed capture object and preview for image data

claim: Capture and export make no outside request.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; capture and export both formats while recording requests; assert no outside origin is contacted

claim: The site loads no third-party scripts, fonts, or analytics.
sandbox: fresh demo context; record every request and assert all are same-origin

claim: The packet shows recorded steps, not an accessibility score.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile with the unpacked extension; export a real packet and assert its UI and JSON contain recorded steps only, with no score, audit, certification, or compliance result
